description_en: Detaches a virtual border router (VBR) from an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 从专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）卸载边界路由器（VBR）
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter detach-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --child-instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --child-instance-type VBR --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The type of the network instance. Set the value to VBR
parameters.help_zh: 网络实例的类型。取值：VBR边界路由器实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. See the Error Codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message. This message is used to replace the `%s` variable in the value of the ErrMessage parameter.

If the ErrMessage parameter returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the DynamicMessage parameter returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
